# Mehtylation_data
```{r d}
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  
library(readr)
library(purrr)
library(here)
})

# 1. List all .tsv files
tsv_files <- list.files(
  path = here("data/Metrics_all_models/methylation_data"),
  pattern = "\\.tsv$",
  full.names = TRUE
)

# 2. Load all files into a named list
methylation_data_list <- map(tsv_files, read_tsv)

# 3. Give the list useful names (filename without extension)
orgs <- c("Multi_organ", "Brain", "Caudal_Fin" , "Intestines")
names(methylation_data_list) <- orgs

methylation_data_list <- lapply(
  methylation_data_list,
  function(df) {
    df$Probe <- paste(df$chr, df$start, df$end, sep = ":")
    df
  }
)


```

## All robust CpGs methylation 
```{r d1}
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
library(readxl)
library(dplyr)
  library(here)
  library(readr)
})
metadata <- read_excel(here("data/final_metadata_uniqueID_new.xlsx"))

methylation_best_cpgs <- read_csv(here("data/Metrics_all_models/methylation_data/methylation_cpgs.csv")) %>%
  mutate(Age = as.factor(Age),
         Organ = case_when(
      Organ == "Fin_clip_caudal" ~"Caudal_Fin" ,
     TRUE ~ Organ
    ),
    Sex = case_when(
      Sex == "F" ~ "Female",
      Sex == "M" ~ "Male"
    )) %>%
  left_join(
    metadata %>% dplyr::select(Sanger_new_ID, individual_fish_ID),
    by = "Sanger_new_ID"
  )


```

# Functions 
```{r e}
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
library(dplyr)
library(rlang)
library(rstatix)
library(purrr)
})

get_signif_per_group <- function(df, y_var, x_var = Treatment, group_var = organ, step_value = 2) {
  yq <- enquo(y_var)
  xq <- enquo(x_var)
  gq <- enquo(group_var)
  
  y_name <- as_string(quo_get_expr(yq))
  x_name <- as_string(quo_get_expr(xq))
  g_name <- as_string(quo_get_expr(gq))
  
  se_fun <- function(v) sd(v, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(sum(!is.na(v)))
  
  df %>%
    group_by(!!gq) %>%
    group_modify(~{
      # if x has <2 groups → empty tibble
      if (n_distinct(.x[[x_name]]) < 2) return(tibble())
      
      # ANOVA
      frm <- as.formula(paste0(y_name, " ~ ", x_name))
      aov_res <- tryCatch(.x %>% anova_test(formula = frm), error = function(e) NULL)
      if (is.null(aov_res)) return(tibble())
      
      pval <- round(aov_res$p[1], 2)
      if (is.na(pval) || pval > 0.06) return(tibble())
      
      # tukey
      tukey_res <- tryCatch(.x %>% tukey_hsd(formula = frm), error = function(e) NULL)
      if (is.null(tukey_res) || nrow(tukey_res) == 0) return(tibble())
      
      tukey_res <- tukey_res %>%
        mutate(
          p.adj = round(p.adj, 2),
          label = case_when(
            p.adj <= 0.001 ~ "***",
            p.adj <= 0.01  ~ "**",
            p.adj <= 0.06  ~ "*",
            TRUE ~ "ns"
          )
        ) %>%
        filter(label != "ns")
      
      if (nrow(tukey_res) == 0) return(tibble())
      
      # vertical positions
      y_max <- .x %>%
        group_by_at(x_name) %>%
        summarise(m = mean(.data[[y_name]], na.rm = TRUE) +
                    1.5 * se_fun(.data[[y_name]]),
                  .groups = "drop") %>%
        pull(m) %>%
        max(na.rm = TRUE)
      
      step <- step_value * se_fun(.x[[y_name]])
      group_value <- unique(.x[[g_name]])[1]
      
      tukey_res %>%
        mutate(
          y.position = y_max + (row_number() - 1) * step,
          group = as.character(group_value)
        )
    }) %>%
    ungroup()
}

```
